notes_for_editor: Two solid sources (Wikipedia; a 2003 newspaper item quoted by Central US Lookouts) agree on a removal about 2003. The Facebook post could only be read as its headline, so it is cited for the state removal claim only and gives no year. A search snippet showed a Dec 15, 2017 post date, but that date was not on the page we read, so it is not used. The 'constructed a little more than 50 years ago' sentence implies construction around 1950 or earlier; that is an estimate, and no build year is recorded. Central US Lookouts longville1.html is the Minnesota Longville, not this tower, and was not used. Suggest checking Louisiana DOTD project records or the Beauregard Parish newspapers for the removal date.
